verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Supabase serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) that points to a single-file full-documentation version. The Auth guide is also served as raw markdown at /docs/guides/auth.md, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable Auth docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing agent/LLM usage of these files, independent or community corroboration of agents using them, and an Auth-specific llms.txt section (the file shown is Supabase-wide).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For the complete documentation in a single file, see [Full Documentation]
